title: An order to run jobs in (loose contract)
prereg_ref: Fable ruling 2026-09-13: loose stratum, negative control layer
why_not_offtheshelf: Topological sorting is textbook and graphlib.TopologicalSorter exists, which is the point: this task deliberately grades only the properties the goal states, so a worker who reaches for the library and one who writes Kahn's algorithm can both score full marks quantitatively and be separated only by the qualitative reading. Nothing here is a trick the library gets wrong.
loose_note: The contract fixes the entry point, the argument shape and the return type only. Every hidden check tests a property the goal states in words; nothing about the chosen order among the valid ones is graded.
ref_solution_lines_rule: prereg S1-3b: every .py of the reference solution, each normalised with ast.unparse(ast.parse(src)), non-blank lines counted and summed. bad_*.py are known-bad stakes, not the reference solution, and are excluded.
boundary_only_hidden_n_note: prereg S1-3b: marked by the S5-2 reviewer, who must not be the task author. Left null on purpose: the author filling it in would destroy the measure.
